name: Ranger

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A wanderer of the wilds who hunts with blade, bow and nature magic, marking prey with Hunter's Mark.

recommended.note: Dexterity first for bows and finesse blades, then Wisdom for spells.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Ranger spells with Wisdom; prepare two to start.
features.text: You prepare level 1+ Ranger spells for which you have slots, as many as the Prepared Spells column shows (two at level 1). When you finish a Long Rest you can replace one prepared spell with another Ranger spell. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability, and a Druidic Focus can be your focus. Your spell slots follow the half-caster progression.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.summary: Hunter's Mark is always prepared; cast it without a slot twice per Long Rest (more uses as you level).
features.text: You always have the Hunter's Mark spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot a number of times shown in the Favored Enemy column (two at level 1), regaining all of those uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.summary: Use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with.
features.text: Choose two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, such as Longbows and Shortswords; you can use their mastery properties. You can change both choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.summary: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, and two more languages.
features.text: Thanks to your travels you gain Expertise in one of your skill proficiencies, and you learn two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.summary: Gain a Fighting Style feat, or Druidic Warrior (two Druid cantrips cast with Wisdom).
features.text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (Archery is a good pick). Instead of a feat you can take Druidic Warrior: you learn two Druid cantrips (Guidance and Starry Wisp are suggested), which count as Ranger spells with Wisdom as your spellcasting ability; whenever you gain a Ranger level you can replace one of them with another Druid cantrip.

options.name: Druidic Warrior
options.summary: Learn two Druid cantrips; they count as Ranger spells cast with Wisdom.

features.name: Ranger Subclass
features.summary: Choose a Ranger subclass.
features.text: You choose a Ranger subclass. From now on you gain each subclass feature when you reach its Ranger level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice instead of once.

features.name: Roving
features.summary: +10 feet of Speed while not in Heavy armor, and a Climb and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
features.text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. The walking bonus is applied; climbing and swimming arrive with terrain that needs them.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Ranger subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Expertise
features.summary: Expertise in two more skills you're proficient in.
features.text: Choose two of your skill proficiencies that lack Expertise; you gain Expertise in them.

features.name: Tireless
features.summary: Magic action: gain 1d8 + Wisdom Temporary Hit Points (Wisdom-modifier uses per Long Rest); Short Rests also remove a level of Exhaustion.
features.text: Primal forces sustain you. As a Magic action you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1); you can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining every use on a Long Rest. And whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, drops by 1.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Ranger subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.summary: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.summary: Bonus Action: become Invisible until the end of your next turn; Wisdom-modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Ranger subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.summary: Blindsight out to 30 feet.
features.text: Your connection to nature gives you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.summary: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take an Epic Boon feat or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet. Boon of Dimensional Travel is recommended.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.summary: The damage die of your Hunter's Mark becomes a d10.
